name: Kozaczkowy
notes:
Uncertain why Agaphia's father has a different last name than hers in the birth record of her son Thimotheus - what is possible is that sometime after Agaphia's marriage to Jacobus Lechow, her mother Xenia remarried.

If true, the marriage record should exist somewhere between 1835 and 1842. The last name of this individual is just a guess.
